Two-Handed Weapon.description: Devastating brawler utilizing massive greatswords, mauls, or polearms to smash targets in single, powerful blows.

features.name: Two-Handed Weapon Style
features.tldr: Synergizes with power attacks, forceful weapon traits, and sweeping cleaves.

Weapon and Shield.description: Defensive bastion combining active shield blocking with reliable striking options.

features.name: Weapon and Shield Style
features.tldr: Enhances shield durability, reactive interpositions, and defensive retaliation.

Dual Wielding.description: Flurry master wielding two weapons simultaneously to overwhelm defenses with a torrent of steel.

features.name: Dual Wielding Style
features.tldr: Unlocks rapid twin strikes, paired weapon interactions, and coordinated multi-attacks.

Ranged.description: Sharpshooting marksman controlling distances with longbows, crossbows, or firearms.

features.name: Ranged Style
features.tldr: Grants specialized overwatch maneuvers, covering fire, and precision distance shots.
